summary: Accept the same message references for conversations send --in-reply-to as conversations read

schema.detail: No schema or wire format changes.

rules.detail: Server-side subject validation and message authority remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The CLI normalizes bare message IDs, encoded references and projected Markdown filenames before sending a reply. Values already starting with message/ pass through byte-identical, preserving their parent and retry key. Malformed noncanonical reply references name the expected message/<id> form.

downtime.detail: No service restart or coordinated upgrade required.

manual.detail: Existing message/<id> references continue to work without changes.

recovery.detail: Message delivery and retry behavior are unchanged; equivalent reply references share the same derived idempotency key.
